extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants / PD/PIs and administrative staff preparing PHS Inclusion Enrollment Reports and inclusion statements for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Completing the NIH PHS Inclusion Enrollment Report and describing inclusion of children/demographic enrollment for a grant application (indicating enrollment type, location, dataset use, trial phase, and age/consent considerations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not use report format to collect participant data
rubrics_metrics.description: This report format should NOT be used for collecting data from study participants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative form guidance: the PHS Inclusion Enrollment Report is for reporting enrollment to NIH, not for primary data collection from participants. Use separate instruments for participant data collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delayed Onset Study indicator
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If study is not delayed onset, the following selections are required (i.e., you must complete the subsequent enrollment/clinical trial selections). Mark the appropriate box.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enrollment Type selection
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select whether the reported enrollment is 'Planned' (projected numbers) or 'Cumulative (Actual)' (numbers actually enrolled). Required if the study is not delayed onset.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using an Existing Dataset or Resource
rubrics_metrics.description: Using an Existing Dataset or Resource — Yes / No
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether enrollment data derive from an existing dataset/resource. Example selection shown: 'No'. If Yes, additional considerations for data provenance may apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enrollment Location
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether enrollment is domestic, foreign, or both. Example: 'Domestic' was selected in this application; there is also an example note about a domestic site where the clinical trial is registered/funded elsewhere but a new measure will be inserted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical trial / NIH-defined phase identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Clinical Trial — NIH-Defined Phase III Clinical Trial (Yes / No)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether the proposed work is an NIH-defined Phase III clinical trial. In the example, boxes for clinical trial and Phase III are present; mark appropriately. Additional contextual comments may be provided (e.g., 'Domestic site (Clinical trial will be registered and funded elsewhere- this proposal will insert a new measure)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Demographic reporting by race, ethnicity, and sex
rubrics_metrics.description: Report enrollment counts broken down by Racial Categories, Ethnic Categories (Hispanic or Latino / Not Hispanic or Latino / Unknown/Not Reported), and sex (Female / Male / Unknown/Not Reported).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form enumerates specific racial categories to report (American Indian/Alaska Native; Asian; Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander; Black or African American; White; More than One Race; Unknown or Not Reported) and requires counts for each by sex and ethnicity. Provide totals and ensure sums are consistent (example tables and totals appear in the form).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children — statement and age criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of Children — describe whether children will be enrolled and specify age ranges and consent requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The application must state whether children will be enrolled and provide rationale/criteria per study aim. Example: Aim 1 (SEARCH PrEP) allows participants ≥15 years and thus may enroll 15–17 year olds, but 15–17 year olds can only start PrEP with parental co-consent; Aim 2 (MTN-025) enrolls former ASPIRE participants aged 18–45 so none <18 will be enrolled; Aim 3 (A5359) requires ≥18 so no children will be enrolled. Cite relevant prior safety data when justifying inclusion (e.g., ATN 113 found safety of TDF/FTC in 15–17 year olds).

rubrics_metrics.name: Safety monitoring for children
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe adverse event reporting and monitoring plans (DSMB) and close follow-up for children if enrolled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If children may be enrolled, the application should describe rigorous systems for adverse event reporting, Data and Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) oversight, and plans for close follow-up of enrolled minors. The example states: 'During the conduct of this study, there is a rigorous system of adverse event reporting (along with a DSMB) and children will be closely followed if enrolled in any of the intervention communities.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide contextual enrollment estimates when applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: When inserting measures into an existing trial/site, provide expected enrollment numbers and demographics (e.g., estimated numbers by sex and race/ethnicity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The example gives a contextual estimate: 'More than 150 participants in the long-acting arm of ACTG A5359, estimate 110 male (40 female) and 30 percent African American, 20 percent Hispanic or Latino.' When the proposal leverages or augments ongoing trials, include anticipated sample sizes and demographic composition for the component being proposed.
